newsitem.title: USA: Polymer amends Merfin bid to C$7.20/shr cash.
newsitem.headline: Polymer amends Merfin bid to C$7.20/shr cash.

text.p: Polymer Group Inc said Tuesday that it is amending its bid to buy all outstanding common shares of Merfin International Inc to an all-cash offer of C$7.20 per share.

Polymer said that it made the new offer in response to concerns by Merfin's board of directors that the time required to accomplish the registration and regulatory approvals of its previous C$7.15 per share bid -- which combined cash and securities -- would unacceptably delay the transaction.
Polymer, said its new offer is subject to 75 percent of Canada-based Merfin's shares being tendered.
On May 9, Merfin directors recommended that its shareholders accept a competing C$7 per share all-cash offer from Buckeye Cellulose Corp.

Polymer said that its amended offer and the consummation of the purchase would not be subject to any financing conditions. It also said it has withdrawn a condition that no break-up fee be made by Merfin to Buckeye.
